Elena P: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few live Qs about Dedicated GA, model routing, and oncall handoff. I'm capturing what we said and assigning owners. Can you confirm or correct?

Raj K: Confirming Dedicated GA target = 2024-05-29 (ETA), canary starts next Mon (2024-05-06) for a week. SLA/billing details to be added to roadmap doc. @Maya L to own billing note.

Maya L: Got it. I'll add billing wording + sample contract snippet by EOD today. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/dedicated-ga

Chris T: For canary routing — do we use region-first or cost-first policy? Also need the canary runbook (how to safely rollback). @Elena P any preferences?

Elena P: Prefer region-first for customers in EU/APAC, otherwise cost-first within same latency SLO. Canary policy example below.

Chris T: I'll build the canary config and a simple toggle for rollback. Will open a PR to infra repo and tag @Jordan R for runbook review.

Jordan R: I'll own the ops runbook and the first-week oncall rotation for the canary. Will sync with oncall team and add escalation steps to the runbook.

Zoe H: QA / evals note — we'll add prompt regression checks for the top-10 customer prompts and an automated metric alert if quality drops >5% compared to baseline. @Elena P please send the prompt list.

Elena P: Thanks — owners summarized:
- Maya L: billing & SLA wording (roadmap doc)
- Chris T: canary config + PR
- Jordan R: ops runbook & oncall handoff
- Zoe H: evals + prompt set
Action items (canary week):
- [ ] PR with canary config (Chris)
- [ ] Runbook draft + paging schedule (Jordan)
- [ ] Billing blurb & contract sample (Maya)
- [ ] Prompt set + evals added (Zoe)
- [ ] Final slide + announcement copy (Elena)

Example canary policy (for infra/traffic):
```
policy:
  priority: region
  fallback: cost
  latency_slo_ms: 200
  rollout: canary_percent: 10 -> 50 -> 100
  rollback_on: latency>250ms || error_rate>2%
```

Elena P: Please drop quick confirms below when you've picked up the item. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Maya L: Confirmed, picking billing.

Chris T: Picked, will PR today.

Jordan R: On it — will add runbook by Friday.

Zoe H: Adding prompts now.
